title: Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure
description:
arXiv:2610.37731v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context.
